description: Create a recurring (cron) or one-time (at) cue in CueAPI.

callback_url.description: Callback URL invoked when the cue fires.

default_payload.description: Default payload object sent when the cue fires.

method.description: HTTP method for the callback request.

require_payload_override.description: Whether firing the cue requires a payload override.

required_payload_keys.description: List of payload keys required for the cue.

schedule.description: Schedule expression, such as a cron expression for a recurring cue or an at time for a one-time cue.

task_name.description: Task name associated with the cue.

timezone.description: Timezone in which the schedule is evaluated, such as UTC.

name: cueapi_create_cue
